tagPolicy.manufacturerFacts: For manufacturer/retailer product entries, names, category tags and factual descriptions are supported by the per-product sourceUrl. Services are locally authored sample definitions, not manufacturer claims. Prices are illustrative USD.
tagPolicy.colloquialAliases: e-bike and emtb are user-requested colloquial search aliases for verified electric-assist mountain bikes; they are not extra specifications.
tagPolicy.informalYetiAlias: dentist-bike is a user-provided informal demo search alias on Yeti mountain-bike listings only. It is not a manufacturer fact, intended-rider claim, or affordability statement.
tagPolicy.serviceIntentAliases: LABOR uses curated workshop/maintenance intent terms. wrench-monkey, grease-monkey, bike-whisperer and spanner-man are user-requested informal demo aliases, not manufacturer facts, staff designations, guaranteed operations or included parts.
